summary: The ibm.qradar collection is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 13 unless it regains a maintainer.
questions: Is ibm.qradar being removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: ibm.qradar is deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: As of Ansible 12.0.0, `ibm.qradar` is deprecated and will be **removed from Ansible 13** unless someone starts maintaining it again before then.
